features.name: Integrated Protection
features.description: Your body has built-in defensive layers that can be enhanced with armor. You gain a bonus to Armor Class equal to half of your proficiency bonus rounded down. You can don only armor with which you have proficiency. To don armor, you must incorporate it into your body over the course of 1 hour, during which you must remain in contact with the armor. To doff armor, you must spend 1 hour removing it. You can rest while donning or doffing armor in this way. While you live, your armor can't be removed from your body against your will.

features.name: Iron Fists
features.description: You can use your iron fists to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier force damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

features.name: Specialized Design
features.description: You gain one skill proficiency and one tool proficiency of your choice.
